text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Was this room always such a mess? 
There's nowhere to even step!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still, rough waters like this are nothing 
if I just keep my steps light! Piece of 
cake!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha, easy peasy! It's no big—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That's weird~ I really thought that would 
work...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, having cleaned her room, Tap 
Dance City was utterly exhausted.
